commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  listado -e C0_PC_FIX_1600 | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -c Pc_MultiSource_1 -t 160000 -
  listado -e C0_PC_FIX_1600_A | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -c Pc_Default -t 160000 -  
else
  listado -e C0_PC_FIX_1600 | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -d $BusinessDate -c Pc_MultiSource_1 -t 160000 -
  listado -e C0_PC_FIX_1600_A | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -d $BusinessDate -c Pc_Default -t 160000 -  
fi
jobDescription: This is a command execution job! It executes a script and possible has some parameters passed to it.
